settings.text: Custom Milled Putters — Antares & Orion, Handcrafted in Italy
Light years ahead. Designed to win.

GG Putters are precision golf putters milled from a single block of aluminum and steel in Brescia, Italy, featuring a 3-position adjustable weight system and interchangeable faces for a straighter, more confident roll.

content.name: heading
content.label: h2: Why players choose our p

settings.text: Three engineering choices — billet milling, adjustable weighting and interchangeable faces — combine to deliver a cleaner, more repeatable stroke.

content.name: block
content.label: Feature: Milled from a single block

content.name: heading
content.label: h3: Milled from a single blo

settings.text: A milled putter is machined from one solid metal block for tighter tolerances and a more consistent face.
Each head is milled from a single billet of aluminum, combined with steel components and worked by turning and milling without heating to preserve the metal's natural elasticity and strength.
An adjustable weighting system lets you reposition the three head weights to match your stroke arc and balance.
Move the three weights across three dedicated points to fine-tune the arc and balance — light and heavy options let you compensate for individual stroke tendencies.
Interchangeable face inserts and necks let you tune feel, loft and alignment without changing putter.
Choose clubfaces from 1° to 3° and necks with different lie and offset to optimize feel and responsiveness for any green speed.
Choose your putter: Antares or Orion
Two milled putters, both €353: the Antares blade for feel and the Orion mallet for stability. Clubhead-only options start at €285.

settings.text: The Antares is a blade putter for golfers who favour feel and an arc-style stroke.

• Milled aluminum + steel head
  • 3-position adjustable weights
  • Interchangeable faces 1°–3°
  • Lie & offset necks available

settings.text: The Orion is a mallet putter engineered for stability and higher forgiveness (MOI).

• Milled aluminum + steel head
  • 3-position adjustable weights
  • Interchangeable faces 1°–3°
  • Straighter, immediate roll
Antares vs Orion: which putter is right for you?
Quick answer: choose the Antares blade for feel and arc strokes, the Orion mallet for stability and forgiveness. Both cost €353.

settings.text: Italian Craft, Brescia Engineering — Made in Italy, Game-Ready
GG Putters is a golf brand by GM PRODUCTION srl, born in a garage in the 1980s in the Oglio river valley near Brescia, Italy — a region with a centuries-old metalworking tradition.

Every putter is milled in-house from premium materials, turned and milled without heating to preserve the metal's original elasticity and strength. The fusion of decades of metalworking expertise and a love for golf gives life to a genuinely unique, fully customizable product.
